caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow dish or plate with a decorative central image. In the middle, there are two human figures standing side by side. Both are dressed in red coats, green trousers, and black shoes, each with light pink hats adorned with a dark feather. The figure on the left appears to be holding a stick or cane in one hand and has the other arm bent by the waist; the figure on the right is playing a flute or pipe, with both hands near the mouth and elbows bent outward. Surrounding the figures are stylized plants or flowers on either side, with green leaves and large, curling petals outlined in red. The background of the plate is a muddy yellowish-brown color, with the rim outlined in a reddish-brown tint. The composition is centered within the circular shape of the plate, and the image is surrounded by a plain, light tan background outside the rim of the dish. The drawing style is simple and uses flat, muted tones.
title: Pa. German Plate
